name: The Ritz Carlton Ras Al Khaima, Al Hamra Beach
positioning: Beach resort of private pool villas on the Arabian Gulf in Ras Al Khaimah, officially The Ritz-Carlton Ras Al Khaimah, Al Hamra Beach
best_for: Couples and families who want a villa with a private pool, beach access and a private cabana
Guests who want beach activities such as archery, kayaking and paddle boarding, with golf nearby

facts.text: The hotel is Responsible RAK Silver Certified for 2026.
The villas feature private pools, sun decks and direct beach access.
Each villa comes with its own private beach cabana.
Dining can be arranged in the privacy of your villa.
The fitness center is open 24 hours.
Guests can visit the sister resort in Al Wadi Desert to explore the nature reserve and meet falcons and owls.
Children's activities include shelter-making, nature-inspired crafts and treasure hunts along the shore.
Complimentary continental, grab-and-go and hot breakfast is offered.

highlights.text: Shore House serves grilled dishes made from fish line-caught by local fishermen.
The spa uses private, waterside pavilions for treatments and facials with ESPA and Natura Bissé products.
Archery classes are held on the private white sand beach for adults and children ages seven and older.
Al Hamra Golf Club, nearby, offers 18 holes of PGA-certified beachfront golf.

considerations.text: An appointment is required at the spa.
Golf is at the nearby Al Hamra Golf Club, not on the hotel grounds.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires travel time to reach Dubai's main attractions.
